lanes.summary: The diff perfectly satisfies PMAT-4016. It correctly enforces the llama.cpp fit verdict as the placement gate before any `apr` call is made. It strictly requires 'fits' (full offload at ctx >= 4096, adjusted by trained ctx floor) for GPU cells. The static `fit_audit` and behavioral `fit_probe` test cases verify all conditions (locking, bounds checking, refusal correctly blocking cell measurement). CPU-only fallback correctly records 'not-applicable'. No contradictions or missing requirements found.

The implementation for PMAT-4016 correctly introduces the llama.cpp fit placement gate before executing APR QA calls for GPU-claiming ladder rungs, complete with static audit enforcement (fit_audit), extensive behavioral self-test probe cases (fit_probe), and comprehensive mutant coverage. However, the branch introduced docs/roadmaps/entries/PMAT-4016.yaml without regenerating docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml, causing check_roadmap_fragment_required.sh to fail with exit code 1 (DRIFT). Under refutation doctrine, this failure refutes the diff at HEAD.

findings.fix: Run `make roadmap-aggregate` and commit the regenerated docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml.
